consumers: both trainers, checkpoint monitors, annual scorers and weekly diagnostics consume exactly these masks
loss_scale: FIT-only naive MAE per horizon on the common FIT mask, shared by both arms
missing_bars: a missing open-session bar is a counted exclusion, never filled
population: per split separately, the intersection of the (origin row_id, horizon) pairs valid under BOTH treatments (exact market slots, C1 MANAGEMENT label support, split purge and label maturity); only origins with >= 1 common valid head are retained; frozen with ordered row ids, per-head counts, entry/management masks and typed exclusions BEFORE either fit
scaler: ONE FIT-only feature mean/std (ddof=0) over the UNION of MG1-long/MG12 input-source bars of the common FIT origins, with its exact source-row digest; the same statistics serve both arms; INNER/DEVELOPMENT cannot change them

splits.FIT: TRAIN [2020-01-01, 2024-01-01) minus the chronological last eight weeks
splits.INNER: the chronological last eight TRAIN weeks

targets: exact ELAPSED p(t+h); no smoothing, interpolation or next-observed-row targets
test: no TEST row, unit, metadata scan or derived artifact
